newsitem.title: USA: CME pork belly futures speed higher in late trade.
newsitem.headline: CME pork belly futures speed higher in late trade.

text.p: CME pork belly futures sped higher, to session highs, in late trading largely on shortcovering ahead of the weekend, traders said.
Trading volume was thin and several traders said the buying did not appear to be related to cash market factors.
USDA at midday reported cash pork belly prices were weak, with 12- to 14-lb portions trading from $67.00 to $67.50 per cwt.
At 1248 CST, CME pork bellies were up 1.450 to 0.500 cent per lb with February up 1.375 at 77.700 cents per lb.
